title: Modality readiness under stalled ICE
objective: Preserve the exact point at which signaling, transport, media presentation, and RTT readiness diverge when ICE gathering is delayed or incomplete.

historicalBasis.observation: ACE Direct carried a JsSIP 3.5.1 workaround that bounded ICE candidate gathering with a two-second escape path.
historicalBasis.scope: Motivating interoperability evidence only. This scenario does not assert that current JsSIP, browsers, Asterisk, Elixip, OpenMeetings, ACE Omni, or Baudot reproduce the historical defect.

assertions: late observations do not rewrite earlier evidence
requiredBeforeRunnable: at least one deterministic stalled-ICE arm
requiredBeforeProven: explicit RTT observation when RTT is required
terminal verdict bound to scenario inputs

doesNotEstablish: root cause of any contemporary black-screen failure
